$comment: Real .BlizWiz files written by mod authors, read in place and never copied into the repository:
their licence is not established. The root defaults to the AllRaces working tree next to the
coding checkout and is overridden with MODKITX_SC2_WIZARD_CORPUS_ROOT. wizard-corpus.test.ts
runs in the real test tier only.
diagnostics is the baseline in editor-compatible mode with the StarCraft II schema - what the
language provider shows. A change in these numbers is a change in the checker and must be
explained, not re-recorded. Findings believed real: RequierementNode (typo of RequirementNode).
SC2Editor 5.0.16 raises nothing for an unknown object type but drops it when saving: load="Ability"
was exported as <objecttypes/> while Abil survived, and <count> inside <input> was dropped
(runtime-confirmed 2026-09-15, fixtures/editor-saved-export.BlizWiz). Unknown object types are warnings.
2026-09-15: legacy-missing-entry-id warnings were added to the baseline when the checker began
enforcing the documented rule that entry/id is required (fileformat.rtf, read through blizzard/casc).
